data.auto_register_ams: Auto-register new RFID spools loaded into the AMS
data.auto_register_ams_unavailable: Auto-register new RFID spools loaded into the AMS (unavailable)
data.sync_ams_remaining: Sync remaining weight from the AMS to the cloud library
data.sync_ams_remaining_unavailable: Sync remaining weight from the AMS to the cloud library (unavailable)
data.empty_on_removal_pct: Also mark as empty when removed with at most this much left (%, 0 = off)
data.empty_on_removal_pct_unavailable: Also mark as empty when removed with at most this much left (%, 0 = off) (unavailable)
data.deduct_print_usage: Deduct print usage from manually created spools

data_description.auto_dedup_manual: When the AMS registers a new official spool, one matching full, manually created spool is deleted from the cloud library - pre-entered stock no longer turns into duplicates.
data_description.auto_register_ams: When an official RFID spool sits in an AMS slot but is missing from the cloud library, it is added automatically - no need to open the Bambu app or Studio first. Uses the AMS slot sensors of the Bambu Lab printer integration.
data_description.auto_register_ams_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}
data_description.sync_ams_remaining: Pushes the AMS remaining-weight estimate of official RFID spools to the library whenever it changes - like Studio does, but without Studio running. A spool reading 0 % is booked as empty immediately. Uses the Bambu Lab printer integration.
data_description.sync_ams_remaining_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}
data_description.empty_on_removal_pct: Optional extra rule: any spool taken out of the AMS whose last reading was at or below this percentage is set to 0 g, regardless of printing. Leave at 0 unless you want that.
data_description.empty_on_removal_pct_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}
data_description.deduct_print_usage: Bambu never books consumption for third-party spools. With this on, every print job finished after enabling is booked once against the manual spool the library shows in that AMS slot, using the per-slot grams the cloud records for the job. RFID spools are never touched; jobs already booked elsewhere are skipped. Cancelled jobs are booked proportionally when the printer integration saw the progress.
data_description.empty_on_runout: The safe runout rule: a spool that was the active tray of a running or paused print (an AMS backup switch is remembered too) and is then taken out of the AMS before that print ends is set to 0 g. Spools removed after a finished print, or mid-print with more than 20 % left (filament change), are never touched.
data_description.empty_on_runout_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the filament library from the Bambu cloud immediately.

set_remaining.name: Set remaining weight
set_remaining.description: Set the remaining filament weight of a spool in the cloud library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

remaining_g.name: Remaining weight
remaining_g.description: New remaining filament weight in grams (without the spool itself).

set_note.name: Set note
set_note.description: Set the note of a spool in the cloud library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

set_filament_id.name: Set slicer profile (filament ID)
set_filament_id.description: Link a spool to a Bambu filament profile so Bambu Studio can assign it with matching print settings (e.g. GFA00 for Bambu PLA Basic, GFL99 for Generic PLA). An empty string unlinks the profile again.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

filament_id.name: Filament ID
filament_id.description: Bambu filament profile id from the catalog (get_catalog action), or empty to unlink.

create_spool.name: Create spool
create_spool.description: Add a new spool to the Bambu cloud filament library (appears in Studio and the Bambu app too).

material.name: Material
material.description: Material type, e.g. PLA or PETG.

name.name: Filament name
name.description: Product line name, e.g. PLA Matte.

remaining_g.name: Remaining weight
remaining_g.description: Current remaining grams (defaults to the spool size).

filament_id.name: Filament ID
filament_id.description: Optional Bambu filament id (e.g. GFA01); resolved automatically for official filaments.

display_name.name: Custom name
display_name.description: Optional user-facing spool name shown in Studio, the Bambu app and Home Assistant.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note; shown as the spool's remark in Bambu Studio (written right after creation - the create endpoint itself has no note field).

count.name: Count
count.description: How many identical spools to create (1-50), e.g. for sealed stock. All fields apply to every spool.

update_spool.name: Update spool
update_spool.description: Change fields of an existing spool in the Bambu cloud library. Only the provided fields are written; empty strings clear the custom name, note or slicer profile.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

material.name: Material
material.description: Material type, e.g. PLA or PETG.

name.name: Filament name
name.description: Product line name, e.g. PLA Matte.

get_catalog.name: Get filament catalog
get_catalog.description: Returns the vendor/product combinations the Bambu cloud accepts when creating spools.

delete_spool.name: Delete spool
delete_spool.description: Delete a spool from the Bambu cloud filament library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool to delete.
